findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: On arrival there was not a CFPM available on site. Ensure that a CFPM is available on site at all times that they are in operation.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: A food handler was observed to change gloves without hand washing. Education conducted.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The temporary hand washing station is observed in the hand sink on arrival and is deem not easily accessible. It was moved so the inspector could wash their hands and then m oved back after. Education conducted. Ensure that the hand washing set up is easily accessible to promote hand washing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is a buildup of dust on the hood system and portions of the ceiling. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. Ensure that the hood system and ceiling do not have an accumulation of dust by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer spray bottle to measure 0ppm quaternary ammonia. A quaternary ammonia tablet was borrowed from a neighbor and a new sanitizer bucket was prepared, measuring 200ppm quaternary ammonia. Ensure sanitizer is being tested before use to ensure proper sanitization of food contact surfaces. Violation is considered corrected-on-site.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer measured 150 (q) ppm at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the spray bottle is filled with new sanitizer before each event.

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips were not available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC, obtain test strips to have on-site for next season.  Provided PIC with test strips for the day.  Ensure to have test strips on-site and available during business hours.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11(C)(2) (Pf) PIC does not demonstrate the responsibility of preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by employees that may cause food borne disease. Discussed related section of the food code.  Reference 2-102.11(C)(2).

Observed lack of signed employee health reporting agreements. Discussed with PIC. Provided copies for signatures. Inspector will follow-up on 8/28/20.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11  (Pf) Establishment does not have procedures for employees to follow when responding to discharging of vomitus or fecal matter. Provide procedures to comply with this section of the code. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed facility to have copy of clean-up policy, but no bleach or biohazard clean-up kit. Inspector will follow-up on 8/28/20.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.
(B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 
(C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. Reference 5-205.11.

Observed handsink blocked by sani bucket, soap, and single-use knife. Inspector moved all items to wash hands. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 0-100 ppm at sani bucket. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Reference 4-501.114.

Observed sani bucket to have 0-100 ppm of quat. Inspector added tablet and mixed. Corrected to 200 ppm. COS.

findings.title: Compliance with variance/specialized process/HACCP
findings.citation_text:
8-201.13  (C) A HACCP plan has not been provided for approval as specified under 8-201.14 to validate a food processing method for sous vide meats that requires a variance. The HACCP plan and variance must be approved before the food is prepared at the food establishment. Reference 8-201.13.

Observed facility to sous vide meats (brisket, chicken, pork, etc.). Facility must have HACCP plan available. Copy needs to be approvied and provided to SCDPH.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on ceiling fans. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

Observed ceiling fans to have a large accumulation of dust. Please ensure fans are cleaned before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment: Cheese sauce observed in the R-I Cooler at 41F probed and dated 8/8. Cheese was discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Observed individual doing multiple tasks with gloves on. *Contaminated Gloves touched RTE foods. Ensure proper glove use and handwashing occurs. Corrected. Education Provided.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14  (P) Employee changed gloves without washing hands between tasks. Food employee must practice good hygiene by properly washing hands when changing tasks. Reference 2-301.14.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed handsink to be blocked by food and equipment. Ensure handsinks are always accessible.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by food and equipment.  Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment: Observed pork to be at 121F. Ensure proper hot holding occurs. Correct. Products will be used in 4 hours or discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1)  (P)  Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 135°F, or above. Reviewed hot holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was rapidly reheated to above 165°F ***** discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(1).
